critical_code_review_comments: The claim in the review_request that the file was updated to PARALLAX=0.5/200%/-50% is not reflected in the on-disk source. Either the edit was reverted, never saved, or a caching/hot-reload issue prevented persistence. The live bundle served by REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL matches the on-disk 0.36 values (transforms come out to multiples of 6%, not 8.33%).

tweenParallax uses clamp of ±1.2 with PARALLAX*-100, so max |tx| = 1.2 * PARALLAX * 100 = 43.2% at 0.36 (safe with 40% margin - just barely). If PARALLAX is bumped to 0.5 the clamp should be tightened to ±1.0 or margin widened to 50% (i.e., left:-50%, width:200%) — which is exactly what main agent claimed to do. Note: with clamp ±1.2 and PARALLAX 0.5 max |tx| = 60% which would EXCEED even the 50% margin; recommend also changing clamp to Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, diff)) when applying the bump.

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the failing parallax-strength assertion: the PARALLAX constant and image sizing in WhereItGoes.jsx were never actually updated on disk. The main agent's description of the change (PARALLAX=0.5, width:200%, left:-50%) does not match the current file content (PARALLAX=0.36, width:180%, left:-40%). Reproduction: `grep -n 'PARALLAX\|width:\|left:' /app/frontend/src/components/titli/WhereItGoes.jsx` shows the old values. Runtime confirmation: parsing translate3d X% values before/after a single ArrowRight yields deltas of exactly 6% * 0.998 = 5.988% (which is PARALLAX*100/6 = 0.36*100/6 = 6.0% multiplied by the fraction of scrollProgress traveled). Mitigation: main agent must reapply the edit and confirm the file diff before re-requesting a retest. Also consider tightening the diff clamp from ±1.2 to ±1.0 when PARALLAX=0.5 to keep max |tx| at exactly 50% (matches the 50%-per-side coverage margin).
